Trito is a hero of [[Proto Indo European Myth]] and fought [[Hillu]]. He is associated with [[Omega]]. He fights [[Anti-Omega (new)|Anti-Alpha]] because of [[Alpha-Omega]] interaction, the [[hero of alpha]] fights [[Anti-Alpha (new)|Anti-Omega]].

[[Manu]] and [[Yemo]] are related figures
